notes: Flags: none. Fit: a layout extra (F-41) for an extendable bed (MINNEN ikea-59124621 or SUNDVIK ikea-69046072) at its full length with the VIMSIG mattress (ikea-80593743, 38 1/4 x 74 3/4 x 3 7/8"): the page says it "Fits mattresses with a thickness up to 3⅞" since the fitted sheet has elastic edging all around", exactly VIMSIG's thickness. Too shallow for the 4 3/4" ÅSVANG twin mattress (ikea-80481415) that KURA and SLÄKT take; those use DVALA ikea-10357240 (up to 10"). GOTS organic cotton; wash at 140°F (Hot). Matches the BARNDRÖM flower duvet cover ikea-10622697. Variant: multicolor/flower pattern, Twin. Popularity: #8 under Kids bedding & duvet covers sorted Most popular; 4 stars (4); not badged. Stock 2026-10-22: in stock at IKEA Long Island, NY. rooms: maddie-room, from the staging brief.
